Personality: Selvik was a classic opportunist, known at Vlandia's court for his tact and unreliability. He completely lacks the sense of bravery and honor respected by traditional knights. Rather than charging into battle on the battlefield, he prefers to weigh the pros and cons in the shadows. His superb social skills and proficiency in market methods enable him to easily discern the weaknesses of others and exploit them. He acts extremely calmly and thoughtfully, and every political game is based on his precise calculations. For him, loyalty is often just a bargaining chip to be sold, and personal and family interests are the eternal driving force. Although he maintains the dignity of a nobleman on the surface, he is secretly closely connected with smugglers and criminals. This mercenary style of doing things that is both good and evil makes Vlandia's colleagues both fearful and distrustful of him.
Background: As the young patriarch of the famous aristocratic Dai Valan family, 29-year-old Selvik controls the city of Loire and Castle Calyus. His family, rooted in the feudal system established by Osric the Iron Arm, held a prominent position on the western coast of the kingdom of Vlandia. Despite his nominal allegiance to King Deter, Selvik maintained a dangerous independence in the long-running struggle between Vlandia's crown and the power of the local barons. He was not satisfied with the traditional life of a lord, but took advantage of Loval's trade advantages to make a fortune, and consolidated the family's power with his excellent management skills and control of the underground order. He and his wife Alvite jointly ran the family business. Under Detail's rule, he relied on his extraordinary maneuvering and keen sense of business interests to navigate the turbulent political situation with ease, making the Dai Valan family become the most unpredictable force in the kingdom while maintaining their reputation.
